question: In the energy flow diagram of an ecosystem, the flow of energy comes to herbivores from:
solution:
The correct answer is __**producers**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Producers** are organisms, typically plants, that produce energy through photosynthesis using sunlight.
 
• In the energy flow diagram of an ecosystem, energy from the sun is captured by **producers** (plants) and then transferred to herbivores when they consume the plants.
